newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to seek support around 100.50 area.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to seek support around 100.50 area.

text.p: June Bund futures traded on LIFFE will seek support in a band between 100.66 and 100.53 on Monday, technical analysts said.

"Just for today it is probably worth buying it in that area for a trip back up towards the top of the range it is trying to create," said David Wood, an independant technical analyst near London. "The top of that range being up at 101.00 to 101.14."
At 0655 GMT, June Bund futures were just within that support area at 100.65, down 17 basis points on the day.
The contract had stretched down to 100.59 in early trade, just above the April 16 low at 100.53.
"Depending on your pain threshold you could put a stop under 100.53," said Wood. "If you could stand it, you could place a stop down at 100.38."
On daily charts 100.38 was the low on April 10.
He said in the longer term the 100.50 to 100.60 area ought to be a good area to rally from.
"If it is going to rally from anywhere in the bigger picture it should be trying to do it from around here, but you need to give it a bit of room," he said.
But Wood said things would look gloomy if the contract closed below 100.53.

Tim Hampton, head of futures sales at Royal Bank of Scotland in London, said an hourly trendline came in at 100.95 and the fact Bunds had opened below that had introduced early pressure to the market.
"Hourly charts are looking tired with sharp idvergence indicating a turnaround and another challenge of 100.50," Hampton said in a note to clients.
"Thursday's value area is now resistance from 100.92-101.00 and low intensity forays into this area should be sold."
Wood placed initial resistance at 100.77 to 100.86, from intraday lows and highs on Friday.
At the short end, June Euromarks were at 96.74, down one basis point on the day, while the September contract was at 96.69, also down 0.01.
